newsitem.title: USA: Fairchild Semiconductor sells $300 mln junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Fairchild Semiconductor sells $300 mln junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement offering of high-yield corporate bonds from Fairchild Semiconductor Corp was priced via lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston on Thursday, according to market sources.

Fairchild is being spun off from National Semiconductor Corp in a management-led leveraged buyout. Citicorp Venture Capital and National Semiconductor will also be part-owners of the new company, sources said.
The company manufactures semiconductor products used in a variety of products such as household appliances and computers.
The size of the deal was increased to $300 million from $250 million due to strong market demand, a source said.
